lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ zhǎodào xīn gōngzuò le?
lines.english: Heard you found a new job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Shì de, shàng gè xīngqí kāishǐ de.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 很好。钱比以前多，离家也近。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Qián bǐ yǐqián duō, lí jiā yě jìn.
lines.english: Very good. More money than before, and closer to home.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 还是经理。但这家公司比较大。
lines.pinyin: Háishì jīnglǐ. Dàn zhè jiā gōngsī bǐjiào dà.
lines.english: Still a manager. But this company is bigger.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 很好。大家都很热情，帮我了解新环境。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Dàjiā dōu hěn rèqíng, bāng wǒ liǎojiě xīn huánjìng.
lines.english: Very good. Everyone is warm and helps me understand the new environment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 太好了！希望你新工作开心。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xīwàng nǐ xīn gōngzuò kāixīn.
lines.english: Great! I hope you enjoy your new job.
